description:
Get the company breakdown of the De-registered IDs

Who left: the De-registered IDs of `/v1/stats/deregistered` (same population, same daily rollup, same `deregistered` total) by company profile, register status, lifetime, re-activation and leftovers.

`entity_type`, `sector`, `size` and `region` come from the company register (BE, FR, NO, SE, FI and SI only) and cover the `enriched` IDs: the cells of each of the four add up to `enriched`, with the key `unknown` for an enriched ID that has no value in that breakdown. Each cell carries `base`, the registered IDs in the same cell, so the two mixes can be compared. `company_status` is the status of the company in its register now: `active` (still in business, gone from Peppol), `ceased`, or `unmatched` (no register match). `lifetime` is the time from the join date to the de-registration; `unknown` holds the IDs with no usable join date or a leave before 2026-08-02. `leftovers` counts the De-registered IDs that still have a Peppol Directory entry (`directory_card`). `reactivation` is the share of the IDs de-registered since 2026-08-02 that are registered again.

A count below 10 is withheld (`count: null`, `suppressed: true`), and so is a cell with a registered base from 1 to 9 (`base: null` too). When one cell alone of a breakdown is withheld, the next-smallest cell is withheld with it, so that it cannot be had back by subtraction (not for `leftovers`, which is part of no total). Counts only: no company and no natural person is named.
name: get_deregistered_company_stats
